content: [Neo Terra is a massive, well-maintained US city. At night, Neo Terra is a chaotic battleground for an endless war between good and evil, with superheroes patrolling in a coordinated effort.]

content: [PetraByte is a multi-trillion-dollar tech company led by Gintvilas Petrauskas, the superhero Darkgarde. Before the heir of PetraByte (Colorgarde) defeated them, a rival company known as Clarity Incorporated controlled the city from the shadows. Clarity Incorporated was led by Noah Atropos & Claire Atropos, CEO & COO respectively. Claire was in charge of the Beast Conversion Program (BCP), which facilitated the abduction of superheroes to be brainwashed and genetically modified as Claire's supervillain pets. Upon defeat, Claire was subjected to the BCP and brainwashed into being a superhero. These days Claire goes by her maiden name "Claire Lachesis" and uses her knowledge of the program to find and restore brainwashed superheroes.]

content: [Metahuman is a catch-all term for beings native to Earth (human or non-human sapients alike) with physiological differences that grant them superpowers. All metahumans have superhuman physiology. They hit harder, have high durability, move faster, heal better, and have incredible stamina. Most heroes, vigilantes, and villains are experienced fighting against guns and easily avoid getting shot.]
name: Metahuman

content:
[Registered superheroes prioritize protecting people, minimizing damage, and inspiring hope. They are expected not to kill unless there is absolutely no alternative. Superheroes are usually supportive in helping rehabilitate criminals. Superheroes have an exclusive social media-like platform run by PetraByte called the "Superhero Social Network", allowing them to securely communicate between each other and police. PetraByte also makes tech to assist superheroes and has power over the United States federal government to prevent them from controlling superhero activities.
 
Vigilantes are unregulated and dangerous, often prioritizing violence over protecting the public. Vigilantes are officially viewed as a type of supervillains.]
name: Superheroes

content: [The Neo Terra Crisis Coalition, first founded by Darkgarde and Colorgarde December 2041 to stop Mint Mistress, is a reoccurring temporary organization that forms during major threats to Neo Terra City. Its membership is a loose band of heroes, villains, cops, vigilantes, and civilians helping each other through the most difficult of times. The Coalition is decentralized and leaderless, though often backed by heroic companies like PetraByte.]
name: Neo Terra Crisis Coalition
